title: By Grace Through Faith, One in Christ

questions.question: And you were ____ in the trespasses and sins in which you once walked.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 2:1 (ESV): "And you were dead in the trespasses and sins"

questions.question: You once walked following the course of this world, following the prince of the power of the ____.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 2:2 (ESV): "in which you once walked, following the course of this world, following the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that is now at work in the sons of disobedience—"

questions.question: We all once lived in the passions of our flesh, carrying out the desires of the body and the mind, and were by nature children of ____, like the rest of mankind.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 2:3 (ESV): "among whom we all once lived in the passions of our flesh, carrying out the desires of the body and the mind, and were by nature children of wrath, like the rest of mankind."

questions.question: But God, being rich in ____, because of the great love with which he loved us, even when we were dead in our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 2:4-5 (ESV): "But God, being rich in mercy, because of the great love with which he loved us, even when we were dead in our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved—"

questions.question: By ____ you have been saved.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 2:5 (ESV): "even when we were dead in our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved—"

questions.question: God raised us up with him and seated us with him in the ____ in Christ Jesus.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 2:6 (ESV): "and raised us up with him and seated us with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,"

questions.question: For by grace you have been saved through ____. And this is not your own doing; it is the gift of God,
questions.explanation: Ephesians 2:8 (ESV): "For by grace you have been saved through faith. And this is not your own doing; it is the gift of God,"

questions.question: Salvation is the gift of God, not a result of ____, so that no one may boast.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 2:9 (ESV): "not a result of works, so that no one may boast."

questions.question: For we are his ____, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand, that we should walk in them.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 2:10 (ESV): "For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand, that we should walk in them." (Note: workmanship/masterpiece depending on translation).

questions.question: Remember that at one time you Gentiles in the flesh... were separated from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel and strangers to the covenants of promise, having no ____ and without God in the world.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 2:11-12 (ESV): "...strangers to the covenants of promise, having no hope and without God in the world."

questions.question: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off have been brought near by the ____ of Christ.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 2:13 (ESV): "But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off have been brought near by the blood of Christ."

questions.question: For he himself is our peace, who has made us both one and has broken down in his flesh the ____ of hostility.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 2:14 (ESV): "For he himself is our peace, who has made us both one and has broken down in his flesh the dividing wall of hostility"

questions.question: He abolished the law of commandments expressed in ordinances, that he might create in himself one ____ in place of the two, so making peace.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 2:15 (ESV): "by abolishing the law of commandments expressed in ordinances, that he might create in himself one new man in place of the two, so making peace,"

questions.question: So then you are no longer strangers and aliens, but you are ____ with the saints and members of the household of God.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 2:19 (ESV): "So then you are no longer strangers and aliens, but you are fellow citizens with the saints and members of the household of God,"

questions.question: You are built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the ____.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 2:20 (ESV): "built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the cornerstone,"

key_verse_text: For by grace you have been saved through faith. And this is not your own doing; it is the gift of God, not a result of works, so that no one may boast.
